Name: Sherbet Thieves
Overview:
The orbital sherbet farms are under attack! Strap on your jetpack and defend the tasty crop from aliens, hungry stoners, pirates, and sherbet thieves!

Twin-stick arcade action sherbet defense simulation excitement awaits you! 3 levels of difficulty, 19 hilarious story-mode levels, and a never-ending survival mode.

Grab a friend for co-op sherbet party!
